scores.tell: Cap's blue visor and white crown are smooth, rubbery gloss with no fabric weave or stitching. Background wood grain is large and decorative.
The air conditioner is one uniform glossy plastic. The airflow is a soft glowing smear, and the wall stripes are flat.
Green canvas has fine stitching and the metal tubes look metallic. The slight smoothness is minor.
Chest wood grain is fine and the gold is glossy. The coins and gems are all equally shiny, and the sand is soft and noisy.
Wood grain on the podium is large and swirly, and the planks are chunky and decorative. The curtain texture is a soft painterly smear.
Matte, soft-sheen felt on the hat with a crisp small gloss on the buckle. The surface is smooth with controlled highlights, matching the real towel and swing cards.
Slide is uniformly glossy plastic. The pool tile and water have fine detail, but there is little matte and gloss variety.
Whole machine is lacquered plastic. The glass and the bears have the same sheen, and there is no fine detail.
Canvas cover has soft fabric folds and small rivets, and the wood is quiet. The paint is a little smooth and the gloss on the wheel rim is a bit even.
Straw bristles have fine strands, the handle is smooth wood, and the red binding is glossy. Matches the real towel and saddle cards. The gloss is slightly even.
